liveMap.geometry: Integer 16px tiles at 1x or 2x; native 16x32 traveler with bottom-center anchor at the perceived tile foot.
liveMap.knowledge: Remembered terrain; only occupants/objects supplied in the current public observation. No persistent occupant cache or species inference.
liveMap.movement: No art controller, pathfinding, collision or game rules. Named library operations own all game behavior.
liveMap.symbols: Class art in src/symbol-art.ts; original glyphs retained in inspection, text map and optional symbol mode. No species/item identity inference.
